description: Stable image identifier (content hash); sidecar field id
S3 object key for the image file
Image file extension; release images are JPEG
Crop species depicted in the image; sidecar: agronomic_properties.crop_type
Collection site or research centre identifier; sidecar: location_properties.site
Contributing research centre or station (may match or refine site)
Country of collection (ISO-3166 alpha-3 when from sidecar admin_level_0)
Year of capture
Growing season when available: fall, spring, summer, or winter; may be inferred from object key
Image capture date in YYYY-MM-DD form; sidecar: acquisition_properties.date
Local capture time in HH:MM:SS when available; sidecar: acquisition_properties.time
GPS latitude in decimal degrees; sidecar: location_properties.latitude
GPS longitude in decimal degrees; sidecar: location_properties.longitude
Elevation in metres when available; sidecar: location_properties.elevation_m
Coordinate reference system; sidecar: location_properties.crs (e.g. EPSG:4326)
Phenological growth stage at time of capture; sidecar: agronomic_properties.growth_stage
Plot identifier linking imagery to field records; required for Artemis trials; sidecar: location_properties.plot_id
Variety or genotype identifier
Applied treatment or management factor
Acquisition platform: push-cart, handheld, GoPro, or smartphone
Capture device class when available (e.g. mobile); sidecar: device
Image-acquisition approach or device class (e.g. phone_approach); may be derived from object key
Camera viewpoint: top-down, above-canopy, or under-canopy
Camera angle relative to the horizontal when recorded as a single summary value
Camera azimuth in degrees; sidecar: acquisition_properties.azimuth
Camera pitch in degrees; sidecar: acquisition_properties.pitch
Camera roll in degrees; sidecar: acquisition_properties.roll
Illumination source; sidecar: acquisition_properties.light_source (e.g. natural)
Camera manufacturer; sidecar: camera_properties.make
Camera model; sidecar: camera_properties.model
Image height in pixels; sidecar: image_quality.height
Image width in pixels; sidecar: image_quality.width
Image orientation: portrait or landscape; sidecar: image_quality.orientation
standard or benchmark
Annotation representation: bounding box, masks, point, scribble, polygon, instance_segmentation, object_detection, image_classification, or semantic_segmentation
Granularity at which the ground-truth observation was recorded; image-linked means the value applies to the individual image
Measured trait: pod_count, open_flower_count, open_flower_presence, plant_stand, disease_score, disease_presence, cbb, or als
Recorded value for groundtruth_trait; a number for count or score traits or YES/NO for presence traits
TRUE or FALSE indicating presence of ground truth
